arguments.code:
# Login + compute artists to follow, then follow them and verify

import math

token=None
# get spotify creds from supervisor
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spw=[c for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']

login_res=apis.spotify.login(username='vicpowe@gmail.com', password=spw)
token=login_res['access_token']

# fetch all liked songs
liked=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    liked.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('liked songs total',len(liked))

liked_artist_map={}
for s in liked:
    for a in s.get('artists',[]):
        liked_artist_map[a['id']]=a['name']
liked_artist_ids=set(liked_artist_map.keys())
print('unique liked artists',len(liked_artist_ids))

# fetch all following artists
following=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit,sort_by='-followed_at')
    if not page:
        break
    following.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('following artists total (before)',len(following))
following_ids=set(a['artist_id'] for a in following)
print('already following unique ids',len(following_ids))

# compute artists to follow
need_follow_ids=sorted(liked_artist_ids - following_ids)
print('need to follow count',len(need_follow_ids))
print('need_follow_ids',need_follow_ids)
print('need_follow_names',[liked_artist_map[i] for i in need_follow_ids])

# follow each
results=[]
for aid in need_follow_ids:
    res=apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid,access_token=token)
    results.append((aid,res))
print('follow results count',len(results))
print('follow results sample',results[:3])

# verify: fetch following artists again
following2=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit,sort_by='-followed_at')
    if not page:
        break
    following2.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
following2_ids=set(a['artist_id'] for a in following2)
print('following artists total (after)',len(following2))

remaining=sorted(liked_artist_ids - following2_ids)
print('remaining not-following count',len(remaining))
print('remaining ids',remaining)
print('remaining names',[liked_artist_map[i] for i in remaining])
